title: Koko Eating Bananas
description: Koko loves to eat bananas. There are n piles of bananas. The ith pile has piles[i] bananas. Koko can decide her bananas-per-hour eating speed of k. Each hour, she chooses a pile and eats k bananas. If the pile has fewer than k, she eats all of them and won't eat any more during that hour. Return the minimum integer k such that she can eat all bananas within h hours.
